text:
tara_sales: Heads-up  AstraBank POC demo failed 10m ago. They POSTed a single JSON with lots of embedded PDFs and got HTTP 413. Need a one-pager we can send to them fast.

ben_support: 413 = upstream rejecting body. Do you have the request example?

tara_sales: They pasted a sanitized curl in the ticket:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4x","documents":"<base64 huge blob>","max_tokens":1500}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large

li_engineer: If they're base64-ing PDFs into JSON that's the cause. Base64 expands size and our edge proxy defaults to ~4MB client_max_body_size.

ben_support: Short fixes (ordered by speed):
1) Client-side gzip of the text payload and set Content-Encoding: gzip (edge accepts compressed bodies).
2) Use presigned upload + POST an ingest with the S3 key (server-side fetch).
3) Switch to an embed+retrieve flow so each generate request is small.

tara_sales: They insist on a single HTTP call for the demo. Which is least friction?

li_engineer: Gzip is fastest. But note tokens are charged after decompression so cost could still be high. Also they must not base64 files into JSON. Send raw text or gzipped bytes.

ben_support: Quick gzip curl we can give them: 
```
echo -n "$(cat all_text.txt)" | gzip -c | curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ 
  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \ 
  --data-binary @- 'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate?model=rwd-4x'
```

li_engineer: Also tell them: do not automatically retry on 413. We saw their client immediately retried and then hit 429s for bursts. 413 is client-side fix only.

ben_support: If the gzip path still fails, we can offer a temporary IP exception for the demo window (raise proxy size to 50MB for that IP for 60m). Ops sign-off required.

tara_sales: Demo in 40m. Please request the short whitelist and I'll send gzip snippet now.

ops_bot: ticket-9402 opened -> "Demo body-size exception request for IP 198.51.100.12". Change-ETA: 22m, requires SOC approval.

li_engineer: Post-demo follow-up: provide them a presign + ingest snippet and an example retrieval flow (embed top-k + include only relevant passages) to avoid token spikes. I'll draft that and attach cost guidance.

ben_support: I'll DM the gzip curl and the presign cURL to Tara now. Tara, include session id AST-992 when they call so we can pull logs if needed.

tara_sales: Thanks all. Sending now and will update after the demo. :thumbsup:
